_comment: Human-editable challenge metadata (NO flags). Run `npm run flag:hash` to combine this with challenge-services/.flags.env into seed/challenges.json (which adds the salted HMAC hashes). Descriptions describe the scenario only, never the solution. Board order is points ascending, then id; the challenge id is the identity. port = the challenge service (any category that runs one); file = a generated capture.

challenges.title: The Snack Cabinet
challenges.description: A developer with a sweet tooth left something behind on this website. It looks like a cookie, but the recipe seems to be scrambled. Can you figure it out?

challenges.title: Open the Hood
challenges.description: Every page is just a document your browser is reading. Someone left a note for the next developer. Take a look at what your browser actually received.

challenges.title: Decode Me
challenges.description: This page loads more than it shows. One of the files it loads holds a message that does not look like English. Find it and make sense of it.

challenges.title: Invisible Ink
challenges.description: The page looks empty. Not everything on a page is meant to be seen.

challenges.title: Locked Button
challenges.description: There is a button that would solve your problem. Someone switched it off. Switch it back on.

challenges.title: Header Hunt
challenges.description: The server has a status page. The interesting part is not on the page. It is in how the server answers.

challenges.title: Price Tag
challenges.description: A shop sells one very expensive item. Look at what the checkout sends to the server, and decide whether the shop should trust it.

challenges.title: Layers
challenges.description: Someone wrapped a message in two layers of encoding. Peel them back.

challenges.title: Storage Locker
challenges.description: Your browser remembers more than you think. Look at what this page stored for later.

challenges.title: Console Whisper
challenges.description: This page talks to anyone who listens. Open your browser's console and see what it is saying.

challenges.title: Gatekeeper
challenges.description: The staff door checks your password before it ever asks the server. Think about who is doing the checking.

challenges.title: Restricted Area
challenges.description: This website has a set of instructions meant for search engine bots. Sometimes, instructions meant to hide things from bots only make them more obvious to a clever human.

challenges.title: Badge Check
challenges.description: The door lets in visitors and staff. It decides which you are by what you carry. Look at what you are carrying.

challenges.title: Guest List
challenges.description: You have a ticket to the event. Every ticket has a number. Someone important has a lower one.

challenges.title: Plain Text
challenges.description: A capture from the intranet is waiting for you. Somebody logged in somewhere they should not have, without any protection. Read the conversation.
